question: What teaching about the practice of the soul has been imparted to the Goddess, and with what force of address is it given?
premises: This practice of the soul is in question.
It has been told to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of that practice is not repeated in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
